newsitem.title: HONG KONG: APT satellite lowers its listing target - report.
newsitem.headline: APT satellite lowers its listing target - report.

text.p: Satellite service provider APT Satellite Holdings Ltd has lowered its listing target by HK$154 million to HK$1.86 billion, eight days before it is due to start trading, the South China Morning Post said on Tuesday.
APT has cut the top end of the range in which it plans to sell shares by HK$1.47, reducing the potential total return from the global offering by HK$154 million, the newspaper reported.
The sale now would raise a maximum of HK$1.86 billion, valuing the company at HK$7.44 billion, it said.
The contraction was made after demand was weaker than expected for the shares initially offered to institutions in the range of HK$15.32 to $19.18, the newspaper quoted sources as saying.
APT's officials were not immediately available for comment.
APT is offering 105 million shares -- 52.5 million for the U.S. market, 42 million for international placement and 10.5 million for public offer in Hong Kong.
Donaldson Lufkin & Jenrette is the sponsor of the issue.
